data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root h-l-h, Haalah means 'free from trouble' or 'delivered from a state of difficulty'. This name has a spiritual connotation in Islam, symbolizing peace and protection from hardships. The name Haalah carries the meaning “Free from trouble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haalah usually hope their child will grow to embody free from trouble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
